payload.decision: Reject H022/T030 without promotion. Select H023/T031 as the immediate bounded state-identifiability gate and queue H024/T032 as an independent analog-retrieval coverage gate.
payload.rationale: The independent audit finds no multi-point implementation defect and closes nearby blend/routing/objective/view spaces. The largest unresolved opportunity is the one-dimensional E003 hidden formation displacement, but legal identifiability is unproven. T031 tests that question before joint TVT modeling; T032 tests an independent retrieval mechanism before selector work.
payload.revisit_trigger: Do not start joint state+spline correction unless every T031 state gate passes. Do not build a retrieval selector unless every T032 oracle-coverage gate passes.
payload.title: Close T030 and select raw-sequence state identifiability
